from (select distinct brief_date from daily_briefs order by brief_date desc limit 30) d","params":[]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/brief","sql":"with pick as (select coalesce($1::date, (select max(brief_date) from daily_briefs)) as d)

      from daily_briefs b join clients c on c.id = b.client_id, pick

    ) x
  ), '[]'::json)
) as data","params":["2026-09-30"]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients/{slug}/adsets/{adset_id}/ads","sql":"with cl as (select id, name, slug, cpl_target_green, cpl_target_red from clients where slug = $1)
select case when exists (select 1 from cl) then json_build_object(
  'client', (select to_json(cl) from cl),

  'ads', coalesce((

             sum(m.leads) as leads, sum(m.phone_calls) as phone_calls, max(m.currency) as currency,

      from ad_level_metrics_daily m
      left join meta_ad_creatives c on c.ad_id = m.ad_id
      where m.client_id = (select id from cl) and m.platform = $4 and m.adset_id = $5 and m.date between $2::date and $3::date
      group by m.ad_id
    ) x), '[]'::json)
) end as data","params":["selftest","2026-09-01","2026-09-30","meta","1"]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients/{slug}/campaigns/{campaign_id}/adsets","sql":"with cl as (select id, name, slug, cpl_target_green, cpl_target_red from clients where slug = $1)
select case when exists (select 1 from cl) then json_build_object(
  'client', (select to_json(cl) from cl),

  'adsets', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x order by x.spend desc) from (
      select m.adset_id, max(m.adset_name) as adset_name,
             sum(m.spend) as spend, sum(m.impressions) as impressions, sum(m.clicks) as clicks,
             sum(m.leads) as leads, sum(m.phone_calls) as phone_calls, max(m.currency) as currency,
             coalesce(max(g.appointments), 0) as ghl_appointments
      from adset_metrics_daily m
      left join lateral (
        select sum(appointments) as appointments from ghl_adset_daily gh
        where gh.client_id = m.client_id and gh.adset_name = m.adset_name and gh.date between $2::date and $3::date
      ) g on true
      where m.client_id = (select id from cl) and m.platform = $4 and m.campaign_id = $5 and m.date between $2::date and $3::date
      group by m.adset_id
    ) x), '[]'::json)
) end as data","params":["selftest","2026-09-01","2026-09-30","meta","1"]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients/{slug}/campaigns","sql":"with cl as (select id, name, slug, cpl_target_green, cpl_target_red from clients where slug = $1)
select case when exists (select 1 from cl) then json_build_object(
  'client', (select to_json(cl) from cl),

  'campaigns', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x order by x.spend desc) from (
      select platform, campaign_id, max(campaign_name) as campaign_name, max(campaign_status) as campaign_status,
             sum(spend) as spend, sum(impressions) as impressions, sum(clicks) as clicks, sum(leads) as leads,
             sum(phone_calls) as phone_calls, max(currency) as currency
      from ad_metrics_daily
      where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date and ($4::text is null or platform = $4)
      group by platform, campaign_id
    ) x), '[]'::json),
  'appts', coalesce((
    select json_agg(z) from (
      with camp as (
        select platform, campaign_id, sum(leads) leads from ad_metrics_daily
        where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date group by 1, 2
      ),
      adsets as (
        select campaign_id, adset_name, sum(leads) leads, sum(spend) spend from adset_metrics_daily
        where client_id = (select id from cl) and platform = 'meta' and date between $2::date and $3::date group by 1, 2
      ),
      same_name as (select adset_name, sum(leads) leads, sum(spend) spend from adsets group by 1),
      booked as (
        select adset_name, sum(appointments) appointments from ghl_adset_daily
        where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date group by 1
      ),
      tagged as (
        select a.campaign_id,
               sum(b.appointments * case when s.leads > 0 then a.leads / s.leads
                                         when s.spend > 0 then a.spend / s.spend else 0 end) appointments
        from booked b join same_name s on s.adset_name = b.adset_name
        join adsets a on a.adset_name = b.adset_name
        group by 1
      ),
      totals as (
        select (select coalesce(sum(appointments_booked), 0) from ghl_metrics_daily where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date) total,
               (select coalesce(sum(appointments), 0) from tagged) tagged_total,
               (select coalesce(sum(leads), 0) from camp) leads
      )
      select c.platform, c.campaign_id,
             coalesce(t.appointments, 0)
               + greatest(totals.total - totals.tagged_total, 0)
                 * case when totals.leads > 0 then c.leads / totals.leads else 0 end as appointments
      from camp c cross join totals
      left join tagged t on t.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
    ) z), '[]'::json),
  'services', coalesce((
    select json_agg(z) from (
      with tagged as (
        select m.client_id, m.platform, m.campaign_id,
               coalesce(csm.service, c.default_service, 'Unclassified') service,
               sum(m.spend) spend, sum(m.leads) leads
        from ad_metrics_daily m
        join clients c on c.id = m.client_id and c.is_active
        left join campaign_service_map csm
          on csm.client_id = m.client_id and csm.platform = m.platform and csm.campaign_id = m.campaign_id
        where m.date between $2::date and $3::date
        group by 1, 2, 3, 4
      ),
      portfolio as (
        select service, sum(spend) spend, sum(leads) leads, count(distinct client_id) clients
        from tagged where spend > 0 group by 1
      )
      select t.platform, t.campaign_id, t.service, p.clients as service_clients,
             case when p.leads > 0 then p.spend / p.leads end as service_cpl
      from tagged t left join portfolio p on p.service = t.service
      where t.client_id = (select id from cl)
    ) z), '[]'::json),
  'targets', coalesce((select json_agg(t) from service_targets t), '[]'::json),
  'trend', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x order by x.date) from (
      select date,
             sum(spend) filter (where platform = 'meta')   as meta_spend,
             sum(spend) filter (where platform = 'google') as google_spend,
             sum(leads) filter (where platform = 'meta')   as meta_leads,
             sum(leads) filter (where platform = 'google') as google_leads,
             sum(spend) as spend, sum(leads) as leads
      from ad_metrics_daily
      where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date
      group by date
    ) x), '[]'::json),
  'ghl', (
    select json_build_object(
      'contacts_created', coalesce(sum(contacts_created), 0),
      'contacts_paid_attributed', coalesce(sum(contacts_paid_attributed), 0),
      'inbound_calls', coalesce(sum(inbound_calls), 0),
      'appointments_booked', coalesce(sum(appointments_booked), 0))
    from ghl_metrics_daily where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date)
) end as data","params":["selftest","2026-09-01","2026-09-30",null]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients/{slug}/creative-health","sql":"with cl as (select id from clients where slug = $1)
select case when exists (select 1 from cl) then (
with ad as (
  select l.ad_id, l.adset_id, l.campaign_id, (l.date > $2::date - 7) cur, max(l.ad_name) ad_name,
         sum(l.spend) spend, sum(l.impressions) imps, sum(l.clicks) clicks, sum(l.leads) leads, sum(l.reach) reach,
         sum(l.unique_link_clicks) ulc, sum(l.unique_outbound_clicks) uoc,
         sum(l.video_3s_plays) v3, sum(l.thruplays) thru,
         sum((select coalesce(sum((a->>'value')::numeric), 0) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(l.raw->'actions', '[]'::jsonb)) a
              where a->>'action_type' = 'landing_page_view')) lpv
  from ad_level_metrics_daily l
  where l.client_id = (select id from cl) and l.platform = 'meta' and l.date > $2::date - 14 and l.date <= $2::date
  group by l.ad_id, l.adset_id, l.campaign_id, (l.date > $2::date - 7)
),
names as (
  select 'campaign' kind, campaign_id id, max(campaign_name) name from ad_metrics_daily
   where client_id = (select id from cl) and platform = 'meta' and date > $2::date - 30 group by campaign_id
  union all
  select 'adset', adset_id, max(adset_name) from adset_metrics_daily
   where client_id = (select id from cl) and platform = 'meta' and date > $2::date - 30 group by adset_id
),
cr as (
  select cr.ad_id, cr.title, cr.body, cr.video_id, cr.image_url, cr.link_url, cr.effective_status
  from meta_ad_creatives cr where cr.ad_id in (select ad_id from ad)
),
bk as (
  select adset_name, sum(appointments) filter (where date > $2::date - 7) cur, sum(appointments) filter (where date <= $2::date - 7) prev
  from ghl_adset_daily where client_id = (select id from cl) and date > $2::date - 14 and date <= $2::date group by adset_name
),
bu as (
  select entity_type, entity_id, campaign_id, status, daily_budget, budget_source
  from campaign_budgets where client_id = (select id from cl) and platform = 'meta'
),
cd as (
  select campaign_id, date, sum(leads) leads, sum(spend) spend
  from ad_metrics_daily where client_id = (select id from cl) and platform = 'meta' and date > $2::date - 45 and date <= $2::date
  group by campaign_id, date
)
select json_build_object(
  'ads', coalesce((select json_agg(ad) from ad), '[]'::json),
  'names', coalesce((select json_agg(names) from names), '[]'::json),
  'creatives', coalesce((select json_agg(cr) from cr), '[]'::json),
  'bookings', coalesce((select json_agg(bk) from bk), '[]'::json),
  'budgets', coalesce((select json_agg(bu) from bu), '[]'::json),
  'campaign_daily', coalesce((select json_agg(cd) from cd), '[]'::json)
)
) end as data","params":["selftest","2026-09-30"]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients/{slug}/creatives","sql":"with cl as (select id, name, slug, cpl_target_green, cpl_target_red from clients where slug = $1)
select case when exists (select 1 from cl) then json_build_object(
  'client', (select to_json(cl) from cl),

  'ads', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x order by x.leads desc, x.spend desc) from (
      select m.ad_id, m.platform,
             max(m.ad_name) as ad_name, max(cn.campaign_name) as campaign_name,
             sum(m.spend) as spend, sum(m.impressions) as impressions, sum(m.clicks) as clicks,
             sum(m.leads) as leads, sum(m.phone_calls) as phone_calls, max(m.currency) as currency,
             sum(m.spend) filter (where m.date <  mid.d) as spend_a,
             sum(m.leads) filter (where m.date <  mid.d) as leads_a,
             sum(m.spend) filter (where m.date >= mid.d) as spend_b,
             sum(m.leads) filter (where m.date >= mid.d) as leads_b,
             max(m.date) as last_active,
             max(c.preview_link) as preview_link, max(c.thumbnail_url) as thumbnail_url
      from ad_level_metrics_daily m
      cross join (select $2::date + (($3::date - $2::date) / 2) as d) mid
      left join meta_ad_creatives c on c.ad_id = m.ad_id
      left join lateral (
        select a.campaign_name from ad_metrics_daily a
        where a.client_id = m.client_id and a.platform = m.platform and a.campaign_id = m.campaign_id
        order by a.date desc limit 1
      ) cn on true
      where m.client_id = (select id from cl) and m.date between $2::date and $3::date
      group by m.ad_id, m.platform
    ) x), '[]'::json)
) end as data","params":["selftest","2026-09-01","2026-09-30"]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients/{slug}/periods","sql":"with cl as (select id, name, slug, cpl_target_green, cpl_target_red from clients where slug = $1)
select case when exists (select 1 from cl) then json_build_object(
  'client', (select to_json(cl) from cl),

  'periods', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x order by x.period desc) from (
      with ads as (
        select date_trunc($4::text, date)::date as period,
               sum(spend) as spend, sum(impressions) as impressions, sum(clicks) as clicks,
               sum(leads) as leads, sum(phone_calls) as phone_calls
        from ad_metrics_daily
        where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date and ($5::text is null or platform = $5)
        group by 1
      ),
      ghl as (
        select date_trunc($4::text, date)::date as period,
               sum(contacts_created) as ghl_contacts, sum(contacts_paid_attributed) as ghl_paid,
               sum(inbound_calls) as ghl_calls, sum(appointments_booked) as appointments,
               sum(jobs_won) as jobs_won, sum(revenue_won) as revenue_won
        from ghl_metrics_daily
        where client_id = (select id from cl) and date between $2::date and $3::date
        group by 1
      )
      select coalesce(a.period, g.period) as period,
             coalesce(a.spend, 0) as spend, coalesce(a.impressions, 0) as impressions,
             coalesce(a.clicks, 0) as clicks, coalesce(a.leads, 0) as leads,
             coalesce(a.phone_calls, 0) as phone_calls,
             coalesce(g.ghl_contacts, 0) as ghl_contacts, coalesce(g.ghl_paid, 0) as ghl_paid,
             coalesce(g.ghl_calls, 0) as ghl_calls, coalesce(g.appointments, 0) as appointments,
             coalesce(g.jobs_won, 0) as jobs_won, coalesce(g.revenue_won, 0) as revenue_won
      from ads a full outer join ghl g using (period)
    ) x), '[]'::json)
) end as data","params":["selftest","2026-09-01","2026-09-30","week",null]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients/{slug}/plays","sql":"with ads as (
  select client_id,
         sum(spend) filter (where date = $1::date) spend_1, sum(leads) filter (where date = $1::date) leads_1,
         sum(spend) filter (where date > $1::date - 3) spend_3, sum(leads) filter (where date > $1::date - 3) leads_3,
         sum(spend) filter (where date > $1::date - 7) spend_7, sum(leads) filter (where date > $1::date - 7) leads_7,
         sum(spend) filter (where date > $1::date - 30) spend_30, sum(leads) filter (where date > $1::date - 30) leads_30,
         sum(spend) filter (where date > $1::date - 14 and date <= $1::date - 7) spend_prev7,
         sum(leads) filter (where date > $1::date - 14 and date <= $1::date - 7) leads_prev7,
         max(date) filter (where leads > 0) last_lead
  from ad_metrics_daily where date > $1::date - 60 and date <= $1::date group by client_id
),
ghl as (
  select client_id,
         sum(appointments_booked) filter (where date = $1::date) booked_1,
         sum(appointments_booked) filter (where date > $1::date - 7) booked_7,
         sum(appointments_booked) filter (where date > $1::date - 30) booked_30,
         sum(appointments_booked) filter (where date > $1::date - 14 and date <= $1::date - 7) booked_prev7
  from ghl_metrics_daily where date > $1::date - 30 and date <= $1::date group by client_id
),
cl as (
  select c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.booking_system, c.target_cpba, c.ghl_location_id,
         a.spend_1, a.leads_1, a.spend_3, a.leads_3, a.spend_7, a.leads_7, a.spend_30, a.leads_30,
         a.spend_prev7, a.leads_prev7, a.last_lead,
         g.booked_1, g.booked_7, g.booked_30, g.booked_prev7
  from clients c join ads a on a.client_id = c.id left join ghl g on g.client_id = c.id
  where c.is_active and (coalesce(a.spend_7, 0) > 0 or coalesce(a.spend_prev7, 0) > 0)
),
dry as (
  select client_id, platform, max(campaign_name) as name, sum(spend) as spend_3
  from ad_metrics_daily where date > $1::date - 3 and date <= $1::date
  group by client_id, platform, campaign_id
  having sum(spend) >= 75 and sum(leads) = 0
),
adc as (
  select l.ad_id, max(m.campaign_name) as campaign_name
  from ad_level_metrics_daily l
  join ad_metrics_daily m on m.client_id = l.client_id and m.campaign_id = l.campaign_id and m.date = l.date
  where l.date > $1::date - 14 and l.date <= $1::date
  group by l.ad_id
),
br as (
  select c.slug, b.brief_date, b.score, b.findings, b.platforms
  from daily_briefs b join clients c on c.id = b.client_id
  where b.brief_date = (select max(brief_date) from daily_briefs)
),
hl as (
  select c.slug, h.check_key from integration_health h join clients c on c.id = h.client_id
  where h.status = 'red' and c.is_active
)
select json_build_object(
  'clients', coalesce((select json_agg(cl) from cl), '[]'::json),
  'dry', coalesce((select json_agg(d order by d.spend_3 desc) from dry d), '[]'::json),
  'ad_campaigns', coalesce((select json_object_agg(ad_id, campaign_name) from adc), '{}'::json),
  'briefs', coalesce((select json_agg(br) from br), '[]'::json),
  'health', coalesce((select json_agg(hl) from hl), '[]'::json)
) as data","params":["2026-10-11"]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients/{slug}/top-ads","sql":"with cl as (select id, name, slug, cpl_target_green, cpl_target_red from clients where slug = $1)
select case when exists (select 1 from cl) then json_build_object(
  'client', (select to_json(cl) from cl),

  'ads', coalesce((
    select json_agg(x) from (
      select m.ad_id, m.platform, max(m.ad_name) as ad_name, max(m.campaign_id) as campaign_id,
             sum(m.spend) as spend, sum(m.impressions) as impressions, sum(m.clicks) as clicks,
             sum(m.leads) as leads, sum(m.phone_calls) as phone_calls, max(m.currency) as currency,
             max(c.preview_link) as preview_link, max(c.thumbnail_url) as thumbnail_url
      from ad_level_metrics_daily m
      left join meta_ad_creatives c on c.ad_id = m.ad_id
      where m.client_id = (select id from cl) and m.date between $2::date and $3::date
      group by m.ad_id, m.platform
      having sum(m.leads) > 0
      order by sum(m.leads) desc, sum(m.spend) asc
      limit $4::int
    ) x), '[]'::json)
) end as data","params":["selftest","2026-09-01","2026-09-30",6]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/clients","sql":"select coalesce(json_agg(t order by t.name), '[]'::json) as data
from (
  select c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.meta_ad_account_id, c.google_ads_customer_id, c.google_lsa_customer_id, c.ghl_location_id,
  c.avg_job_value, c.close_rate, c.gross_margin_pct, c.max_ad_cost_share, c.setter_fee_per_appt, c.default_service, c.trade, c.booking_system,
  c.meta_campaign_filter, c.meta_pixel_id, c.cpl_target_green, c.cpl_target_red, c.is_active, c.created_at, (s.ghl_token is not null) as has_ghl_token
  from clients c left join client_secrets s on s.client_id = c.id
) t","params":[]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/health","sql":"select coalesce(json_object_agg(source, last_success), '{}'::json) as data
from (
  select source, max(finished_at) as last_success
  from sync_runs where status = 'success' and source in ('meta', 'google', 'ghl')
  group by source
) t","params":[]},{"name":"ZMS API · GET /api/overview","sql":"with ads as (
  select client_id,
         sum(spend) filter (where platform = 'meta')   as meta_spend,
         sum(leads) filter (where platform = 'meta')   as meta_leads,
         sum(spend) filter (where platform = 'google') as google_spend,
         sum(leads) filter (where platform = 'google') as google_leads,
         sum(spend) filter (where platform = 'lsa')    as lsa_spend,
         sum(leads) filter (where platform = 'lsa')    as lsa_leads,
         sum(spend) as total_spend,
         sum(leads) as total_leads
  from ad_metrics_daily
  where date between $1::date and $2::date
  group by client_id
),
ghl as (
  select client_id,
         sum(contacts_created)         as contacts_created,
         sum(contacts_paid_attributed) as contacts_paid_attributed,
         sum(inbound_calls)            as inbound_calls,
         sum(appointments_booked)      as appointments_booked
  from ghl_metrics_daily
  where date between $1::date and $2::date
  group by client_id
),
o as (
  select c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.cpl_target_green, c.cpl_target_red,
         c.avg_job_value, c.close_rate, c.gross_margin_pct, c.max_ad_cost_share,
         coalesce(a.meta_spend, 0)   as meta_spend,
         coalesce(a.meta_leads, 0)   as meta_leads,
         coalesce(a.google_spend, 0) as google_spend,
         coalesce(a.google_leads, 0) as google_leads,
         coalesce(a.lsa_spend, 0)    as lsa_spend,
         coalesce(a.lsa_leads, 0)    as lsa_leads,
         coalesce(a.total_spend, 0)  as total_spend,
         coalesce(a.total_leads, 0)  as total_leads,
         coalesce(g.contacts_created, 0)         as ghl_contacts_created,
         coalesce(g.contacts_paid_attributed, 0) as ghl_contacts_paid,
         coalesce(g.inbound_calls, 0)            as ghl_inbound_calls,
         coalesce(g.appointments_booked, 0)      as ghl_appointments
  from clients c
  left join ads a on a.client_id = c.id
  left join ghl g on g.client_id = c.id
  where c.is_active = true
),
spark as (
  select client_id, date, sum(spend) as spend,
         sum(spend) filter (where platform = 'meta')   as meta_spend,
         sum(spend) filter (where platform = 'google') as google_spend,
         sum(spend) filter (where platform = 'lsa')    as lsa_spend
  from ad_metrics_daily
  where date between $1::date and $2::date
  group by client_id, date
),
mix as (
  select m.client_id, m.platform,
         coalesce(csm.service, c.default_service, 'Unclassified') as service,
         sum(m.leads) as leads, sum(m.spend) as spend
  from ad_metrics_daily m
  join clients c on c.id = m.client_id
  left join campaign_service_map csm
